authorization: Owner: Continue. Continues the structures-first city experiment with actual engine layout conditioning.

ENGINE-LAYOUT + STRUCTURES-FIRST CITY EXPERIMENT. Generate ONE new detailed city concept. THREE actual image references have DIFFERENT ROLES:
1) IMAGE 1 is the authoritative C# WORLD LAYOUT DIAGRAM. The coloured rectangular sites and road strokes define exact positions, directions, footprints and open space. Ignore white browser margins; fit the beige world rectangle into the output. This diagram is the PRIMARY layout authority, not artistic inspiration.
2) IMAGE 2 is the SIX BUILDING ARCHITECTURE reference board: top row left-to-right house, office, L-school; bottom row warehouse, factory, stadium. Reuse the recognisable roof forms, cream/blue/terracotta/grey palette and architectural identity. Presentation-cell sizes are NOT relative world sizes. All magenta must disappear in the city.
3) IMAGE 3 is the previous CITY ART reference for ground, paving, vegetation and rendering only. It has WRONG POSITIONS AND TOO MANY HOUSES for this pass. Do NOT copy its block arrangement, road network, building population or extra structures.

Create the city from IMAGE 1's plan, replacing each specified building footprint by IMAGE 2's corresponding architectural identity, at the existing location and relative footprint scale. Keep north at top, high elevated near-overhead orthographic game camera and coherent daylight from upper left. The illustrated ground plan must match IMAGE 1's geometry: the west-east major boulevard bends gently down to the east and passes ABOVE the central park; the continuous north-south main spine passes just WEST of the park and stadium edge; northern road and widely spaced upper distributors remain; the lower bypass runs diagonally UP from southwest toward the southeast junction; its eastern connection turns north along the industrial edge. Preserve every authored road, corner and road connection. Do not regularise curves or straight diagonals into a new block grid. Do not add roundabouts, new diagonal shortcuts, extra road lanes through sites or arbitrary local streets.

Building scope EXACTLY 43 building shells: one large regional stadium in the upper-left site, with continuous white roof ring, blue stands and green field; two pairs of cream-and-blue offices in the two upper-middle/right authored office sites (4 offices total); one L-shaped school at the narrow site immediately west/southwest of the central park; one broad five/six-bay sawtooth factory with two principal red-white chimneys in the right-hand industrial site; one separate low rectangular four-bay warehouse southwest of the factory; 35 small houses in the eight south/west frontage groups marked on IMAGE 1, with counts 4+4+4 down the left column, 5+5+5 down the adjoining column, five in the lower group and three in the small group south of the park. No housing north of the major boulevard or northeast of the park. Match the exact house positions and fronts in the diagram, rather than copying the previous concept's larger villa blocks. Houses must remain small relative to stadium, factory, warehouse and school. Do not enlarge them to fill empty plots. Do not add extra detached buildings, skyscrapers, civic towers or unrequested towns.

The central park keeps its actual compact outline from IMAGE 1, curved interior paths, independently shaped planted beds, football pitch and basketball court at the plan's locations. Place garden strips and yard surfaces within the authored coloured site bands; preserve useful margins and visible access to each building. Keep open unbuilt areas as deliberate warm desert ground or coherent low ground planting, not extra construction. Curbs, sidewalks, crossings, restrained streetlights and a few vehicles may decorate the existing routes without moving or blocking them. Industry has actual loading circulation; residential, school and park grounds remain distinct. No objects float or overlap roads. Render a complete filled ground canvas with desert outskirts, no white/magenta border, labels, diagram colours, footprint boxes, legends, grids, collage panels, UI or text.

This is a DRAFT test of adherence to a specific engine-designed map using the previously generated structure identities. Exact road/site fidelity and relative building scale take priority over adding more scenery or making a more symmetrical city. Preserve the plan's sparse northern/eastern open sites instead of filling them. Produce one city image, not a board or atlas.
